name: What is the process for door replacement with Hometelligent Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for door replacement with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our door replacement process begins with an initial consultation and on-site assessment to understand your needs and evaluate the existing structure. We discuss door options, materials, and hardware, and provide a detailed proposal. Once approved, we schedule the installation. On the day of installation, our team removes the old door, prepares the opening, installs the new door and frame, ensures proper alignment and sealing, and cleans up the work area. We conduct a final walkthrough with you to ensure satisfaction and answer any questions.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an on-site assessment, proposal, scheduling, removal of the old door, new door installation, proper sealing, and a final walkthrough for quality assurance.
